subject: Security questionnaire kickoff + prefill and hosting clarifications
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex@finrise.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Aug 2028 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: security kickoff + prefill and a couple clarifying asks

Alex — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Prefill approach: we typically ask customers to start with the SIG/CAIQ prefill so we can map controls to our SOC 2 report and provide targeted artifacts. I attached our SIG prefill template to make that easier.

2) Clarifying questions from our side (short answers will help us choose the right questionnaire path):
   - Is FinRise scoped for HIPAA-covered processing today (e.g., does the product handle PHI)?
   - Do you require EU data residency for inference outputs or just for stored customer data?
   - Any EMM, corporate SSO, or additional attestations beyond SOC 2 that procurement will require?

3) SOC 2 & artifacts: we can share a redacted SOC 2 summary and a statement-of-compliance letter while the full report goes through legal review.

4) Timeline & next steps: if you can return the prefill within a week, Jordan (copied) will follow up with a 30-minute technical dataflow call to validate hosting/residency details. After that we can route whatever evidence you need (SOC 2 artifacts, encryption detail, KMS/HSM notes).

Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx

Would you prefer we start with SIG or go straight to CAIQ? Either works for us but SIG tends to speed up evidence mapping for enterprise procurement.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
redwood.ai

From: Alex Green <alex@finrise.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Aug 2028 16:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security kickoff + prefill and a couple clarifying asks

Thanks Mateo — good call. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

- HIPAA: FinRise does process limited PHI for a subset of clients (billing codes + limited patient identifiers). We will need BAA language and confirmation of where inference logs are stored.
- Residency: We need EU residency for any data classified as "customer PII" — inference outputs for EU customers should be able to stay in EU.
- Additional attestation: procurement often asks for an encryption whitepaper (at-rest + in-transit) and a brief on key management.

Preference: CAIQ would be fine if it shortens legal review on our end, but we’re flexible. If SIG gives you faster mapping to SOC 2 evidence, start there and we’ll review.

Also attaching our vendor-intake-form; procurement will use it as the canonical source of answers. Can you return the prefill and the intake form to me and CC procurement (Priya Shah)?

Thanks — I’ll aim to get you any internal compliance constraints by Friday.

— Alex
Alex Green
Head of Platform Security | FinRise
alex@finrise.com | +1 (212) 555-0184
Attachment: vendor-intake-form.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: security kickoff + prefill and a couple clarifying asks (internal)

Team — internal notes to prepare the package for FinRise: 

Summary of asks from FinRise:
- BAA & HIPAA scope confirmation (they process limited PHI)
- EU residency support for inference outputs
- Encryption + KMS detail for procurement
- They prefer CAIQ or SIG (both acceptable) and attached their intake form

Proposed deliverables we can share immediately (redacted where needed):
1) SOC 2 redacted summary + SOC 2 cover letter (we keep the full report for NDA review). Attached: SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf
2) Data residency FAQ & hosting options doc — short PDF that explains Hosted API regions, Dedicated/residency options, and Private deployments (VPC/on‑prem). I can draft this quickly; will include dataflow diagrams (high level).
3) HIPAA & BAA note: Legal will need to sign off on specific BAA wording. Jordan — can you confirm technical enforcement (logs residency, log-retention windows, ability to disable persistent inference logs per tenant)?

If you want, I’ll produce the package (SOC2 redacted + FAQ + prefilled SIG) and we can run it past Legal for the BAA carveouts before sending to Alex and Priya.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex@finrise.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finrise.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 11:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security kickoff + prefill and a couple clarifying asks

Alex / Priya — thanks for the quick responses and the intake form. We consolidated answers below and attached the requested artifacts to keep procurement moving.

Short answers: 
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA customers and executes a BAA. Kimberly has attached a short note and our SOC 2 redacted summary; Legal will prepare BAA language for your legal team to review.
- EU residency: Hosted API supports EU region (Frankfurt) and Dedicated/Private deployment options support strict EU residency guarantees. See attached data residency FAQ.
- Encryption & KMS: All customer data is encrypted in-transit (TLS 1.2+) and at-rest (AES-256). For Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed key management; Jordan can confirm per-deployment options on the technical call.

Attached: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx, SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf, redwood-data-residency-faq.pdf

Next steps: 
- Please return the signed vendor-intake-form if you use it as canonical; alternatively return the completed SIG prefill (preferred).
- Jordan will reach out to schedule a 30-minute technical dataflow call (he’s copied).
- We’ll route a draft BAA to your legal once you confirm we should proceed.

If agreed, I’ll also upload the SIG prefill to the Drive link and send a DocuSign for the intake checklist so procurement can track it.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
Attachments: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx; SOC2-redacted-summary.pdf; redwood-data-residency-faq.pdf
